description: This file implements the formLetter class in SuiteCRM, providing methods for generating PDF print links, retrieving templates from the database, and rendering modal popup HTML for template selection.

classes.name: formLetter
classes.description: A class for handling PDF template display and selection in SuiteCRM, including rendering HTML modals and generating template lists.

methods.name: LVSmarty
methods.description: Generates a print-to-PDF link or button based on the SugarCRM version.

methods.name: getModuleTemplates
methods.description: Fetches active, non-deleted templates for a given module from the database.

methods.name: LVPopupHtml
methods.description: Outputs HTML for a modal dialog to select a template for a specific module, with associated JavaScript for handling selection.

methods.name: DVPopupHtml
methods.description: Outputs HTML for a modal dialog with a form to select a template, including JavaScript for form submission upon selection.
